nextSteps: Build for macOS: mobilebuildmcp macos build --workspace-path example_projects/iOS_Calculator/CalculatorApp.xcworkspace --scheme CalculatorApp

Build and run on iOS Simulator (default for run intent): mobilebuildmcp simulator build-and-run --workspace-path example_projects/iOS_Calculator/CalculatorApp.xcworkspace --scheme CalculatorApp --simulator-name 'iPhone 17'
Build for iOS Simulator (compile-only): mobilebuildmcp simulator build --workspace-path example_projects/iOS_Calculator/CalculatorApp.xcworkspace --scheme CalculatorApp --simulator-name 'iPhone 17'
Show build settings: mobilebuildmcp project-discovery show-build-settings --workspace-path example_projects/iOS_Calculator/CalculatorApp.xcworkspace --scheme CalculatorApp
